Why kitchens work with us

Built around the needs of hospitality buyers

  • Own cold storage

    Products are held in our own cold storage facilities with maintained temperatures before dispatch.

  • Expiry checked at dispatch

    Every order is checked for shelf life before it leaves us, so expired stock never reaches your kitchen.

  • Veg & non-veg kept separate

    Vegetarian and non-vegetarian products are stored and handled separately.

  • Delhi NCR base, pan-India supply

    Serving kitchens across Delhi NCR, with supply to customers across India.

  • Dedicated customer care

    A responsive team for orders, availability questions and after-sales support.

  • One supplier, many categories

    Seafood, Japanese & Asian pantry, cheese, chicken and lamb from a single point of contact.

How ordering works

From enquiry to delivery

  1. Share requirements

    Tell us the products, approximate volumes and delivery location — by form, WhatsApp or phone.

  2. Receive availability & quote

    Our team confirms current availability, pack sizes and pricing for your account.

  3. Confirm your order

    Agree quantities, delivery schedule and payment terms with our sales team.

  4. Checked & dispatched

    Orders are shelf-life checked and dispatched from cold storage to your kitchen.
